checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Closed hands keep contact with the resistance band while arms separate overhead.
checks.feet: Prone torso and legs remain stable while straight arms separate into a small Y and stretch the band.
checks.movement: Lie prone holding a resistance band overhead. Keep arms long and torso steady; separate hands laterally into a small Y, pause, return with tension. Band remains attached to both closed grips and clear of the head. 3.5 seconds pull, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds return.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
